$comment: AgentBase import contract — see docs/INTEGRATION_AGENTBASE.md. AgentBase clones this repo, builds the Dockerfile below (repo root as build context), hosts the container, mints the inbound bearer into `authEnv`, and registers each Mastra agent it serves. `agents` is intentionally omitted: AgentBase discovers the hosted agents post-boot via GET /api/agents, so this file never goes stale when you replace the placeholder agents. To pin specific agents, add e.g. "agents": [{ "id": "my-agent", "name": "My Agent" }].
